# Cracktro deck mechanics

Bands, navigation, transitions, audio and animated SVG flows in `docs/public/cracktro/deck.js` (content) and `runtime.js` (engine). Load when changing slide order, groups, transitions, sound or a flow diagram.

- **Bands:** the deck is a table of rows. A slide's `group` is its band: `intro` (title), `platform`, `unlock` (header-less: Enable experimentation. Contain the risk. Unlock transformation.), `security`, `mindset` (header-less, like the title and finale), `process`, `trust` (header-less), `cost`, `engineering`, `enterprise`, `cao`, `data`, `finale`. Rows follow each group's first appearance in the source, except that the `finale` row (`last` in `create`) is always moved last, so changing a slide's `group` moves it to that band without moving its code. Generic human/agent process patterns (swimlane flows with `SEQ`/`LANE` that any team can adopt) belong in `process` ("Human agent processes"); named loops that gh-aw runs on itself (Issue Monster through Personas · Probe · Patch: code quality, specs and docs) and Repo Assist and Merge fast, unslop daily (first under Daily Unsloppers) are worked examples of those patterns: they keep their code at the end of the slides section but use `group: "process"` and `under: "<key>"` to hang in a column below the pattern slide with that `key` (`handoffs`: Event-driven Hand-offs, `prr`: Pull Request Review², `unsloppers`: Daily Unsloppers). Columns work in any band: in `engineering`, Skills in review (the Matt Pocock Skills Reviewer, measured) hangs under Skills (`skills`). `data` ("AW factory") keeps the measured history slides and Patch to PR. The deck.js `// ---------- bands ----------` block holds `BANDS` (id → header title/subtitle), `SOLO` and `PROTO`; runtime.js `create` builds `rows`, moves each `under` slide right after its `key` parent (setting `s.kids` and `k.parent`; an orphan throws), and inserts a generated header slide (`header: true`, `bh-` classes, one tile per main-line slide (examples omitted; a column head shows a `.bh-k` "↓ N" badge) with `data-go` that wrap into a 7-column grid above 8 slides (10 columns above 14) and use the kicker when a heading exceeds 32 characters, plus a band map) at the start of every band except `intro` and `finale`. `PROTO` (group → product name) marks bands that are not shipped product: every slide of the band, header included, gets a dashed "Research prototype · <name>" badge (`.proto`, top right); `cao` (header "Central Agentic Ops", subtitle "CAO · gh cao", badge "gh cao") is one. Each slide then gets `s.band` and each row `r.start`. Slide numbers are absolute and include headers, so adding a slide renumbers everything after it. Only `slides.md` holds numbers: add, move or remove the slide's row there (the tests read it) and nothing else. Headers and slides share their band's `THEME`.
- **Navigation:** three levels: bands, the main line of a band, and columns. Left/Right/Space step along the main line (`nextTop`/`prevTop` skip examples; from an example they continue from its parent) and wrap between bands (Left on a header goes to the last main-line slide of the band above). PageUp/PageDown call `band(±1)`, which always jumps to the first slide (header) of the band above/below (`rows[b].start`); no per-band cursor is kept. Up/Down and vertical swipes call `vstep(±1)`: inside a column (`colOf(s)`: the head or one of its examples) they walk `[head, ...kids]`, and past either end, or on a slide without a column, they fall back to `band(±1)`. Moves within a column use the vertical up/down transitions. The `.vnb` toolbar button (bottom-right dock, `paintColumn`; no overlay) appears only in a column: lit with a bouncing ↓ and the example count `N` on the head, `i/N` on examples (click steps down), and ↑ "Back to the pattern" on the last example. The dots are a mini-map with one `.drow` per band; column heads get `.col`, examples a narrow `.sub` dot. In the slide map each band is a `section.smp-row` region: an `h3.smp-l` header (band title and `#first–last` range) above a `.smp-tiles` auto-fill grid (tiles at least 150px wide, 2 columns at 640px and below). A column is a `.smp-col` block on the same tracks (`subgrid`) spanning the head plus its examples, capped at the grid's track count (`smpFit`, on open and resize): the head tile (badge `↓N`), then its `.smp-t.sub` examples in a dotted, wrapping `.smp-kids` group labelled "<head> examples". On each open, tiles, headers and rules enter staggered by `--d`, rippling out from the current slide (`smpDelay`, capped at 600 ms); any key finishes the entrance first, and `prefers-reduced-motion` disables it.
- **Band themes:** `THEME` (the `// ---------- band themes ----------` block, before bands) is the single source of each band's look and sound; slides never set `sound`, `palette` or `red`. An entry is `{ base, pal, grid: [r,g,b,minorA,majorA], ang, cell, accent, red?, light?, music, prog }`: background fill, four glow colours, grid colour and alphas, grid angle, minor cell size (major lines every 5 cells), header colours, the red security wash (`go()` covers entry with it), the `MUSIC` key played on entering every slide of the band, and per-step semitone shifts (`prog[step % length]`) so the band's music varies along it. Current bands: intro and platform share GitHub brand green 15°, security dark red wash 45°, unlock, mindset and trust are soft grey (#c8d1da) concept slides with no grid (`light: true` sets `body.light`, which darkens slide text and the nav chrome; `go()` stages any light/dark switch: the old slide fades out, the background swaps, then the new slide enters), process blueprint blue 0°, cost gold -45°, engineering purple 30°, enterprise metallic grey -30° (wide cells), cao (Central Agentic Ops, research prototype) deep teal 60°, data violet 0° (fine cells), finale neutral. Other bands use a distinct hue and orientation; the background, grid angle and cell size ease between bands. Keep body text #e6edf3 ≥ 7:1 and muted #8b949e ≥ 4:1 against the brightest glow overlap.
- **Transitions:** derived from `group`. Siblings in a band use a reveal-style horizontal push (`slide-in`/`slide-out`); `show()` sets `--dx` to `100%` going forward, `-100%` going back, and `0%` on first load. Crossing into another band slides up (`up-in`/`up-out`) going forward and down (`down-in`/`down-out`) going back. All use the same 0.8 s curve. Every slide needs a `group`; never add per-slide transition overrides. The old slide keeps the `.leaving` class until a timeout clears it.
- **Audio isolation:** `sfx` methods: `slide, band, step, cut, techno, pop, key, compile, review, notify, omen, route, mr, toggle, unlock`. `master` is a persistent gain that feeds the compressor and delay. `out` is a per-slide bus. `show()` calls `sfx.cut()`, which fades the current bus and replaces it, so long themes cannot leak into the next slide. Any new sound must connect to `out`, or to `master` if it must persist across slides (as techno does).
- **CSS animations restart** through `void el.offsetWidth` before `.active` is added. Prefer `.active .x { animation: ... }` for entry effects.
- **Animated SVG flow diagrams** (for example "Daily Unsloppers"):
  - Built with helpers such as `agent()`, `dev()`, `box()`, `codeScan()` and `ico()`.
  - `EDGES` entries are `[id, svgPath, class, labelLines, lx, ly, anchor]`.
  - `SEQ` entries are `[edgeId|null, nodeLitOnArrival, durationMs?]`.
  - `LANE` maps each node to its lane.
  - The loop length is `START + steps * STEP + HOLD`.
  - On cycle reset, `.on`, `.hot` and `.seen` are removed from the whole SVG, so keep any persistent state (such as counters) outside those classes.
- **Repeated ids:** several slides reuse ids such as `nIssue`, `nDev1` and `nDev2`, and constants such as `HOLD`. When editing, make `old_str` unique by including nearby slide-specific context.
